hero.title: Red Tour
hero.subtitle: Full Day North Cappadocia Tour
hero.desc: Discover Uchisar Castle, Goreme Open Air Museum, Avanos pottery and the magnificent valleys of North Cappadocia.

gallery.title: Experience Gallery
gallery.desc: Explore the stunning landscapes of North Cappadocia

overview.title: Overview
overview.para1: At 9:30, our professional driver and guide will pick you up at your Cappadocia hotel. We will start our journey through North Cappadocia's most iconic landmarks.
overview.para2: Our first stop is Uchisar Castle, the highest rock formation in Cappadocia with spectacular panoramic views. Our guide will explain the landscape and fairy chimney formation while you take memorable photos.
overview.para3: Next, we visit the famous Goreme Open Air Museum, a UNESCO World Heritage Site featuring 10th-11th century cave churches decorated with beautiful frescos and paintings depicting biblical scenes.
overview.para4: We continue to Cavusin Village to explore the abandoned Greek houses from the 1924 population exchange between Turkey and Greece, offering a glimpse into ancient Cappadocian life.
overview.para5: In Avanos, we'll enjoy a delicious buffet lunch at a local restaurant, followed by a visit to an underground cave for a pottery-making demonstration. You'll have the opportunity to try the potter's wheel yourself!
overview.para6: After lunch, we visit Pasabagi (Monks Valley) to see the unique mushroom-shaped fairy chimneys and the Chapel of Saint Simeon. Then we head to Devrent Valley (Imagination Valley), known for its natural rock formations that resemble various animals and shapes.

hero.desc: Discover Derinkuyu Underground City, Ihlara Valley hiking, Selime Monastery and breathtaking Pigeon Valley views.

gallery.title: Experience Gallery
gallery.desc: Explore the hidden treasures of Southern Cappadocia

overview.title: Overview
overview.para1: At 9:30, we'll pick you up from your Cappadocia hotel to begin your Southern Cappadocia adventure. Our first destination is Derinkuyu, one of the most fascinating underground cities in the region.
overview.para2: After exploring the remarkable underground chambers and tunnels of Derinkuyu, we'll head to Ihlara Valley for a scenic 3.5 km hike alongside the Melendiz River. This stunning valley is home to numerous rock-cut churches adorned with beautiful frescoes.
overview.para3: Following our valley hike, we'll enjoy a delicious traditional lunch at a riverside restaurant in Belisirma village, where you can relax and enjoy the peaceful surroundings.
overview.para4: After lunch, we'll visit Selime Monastery, the largest rock-cut monastery in Cappadocia. This impressive structure features churches, chapels, and living quarters carved into the rock face, offering breathtaking views of the surrounding landscape.
overview.para5: Our final stop is Pigeon Valley (Guvercinlik Valley) for panoramic views of Uchisar Castle and the unique rock formations. The valley gets its name from the thousands of pigeon houses carved into the rock faces.

hero.desc: Full-day exclusive adventure with VIP Mercedes, expert guide, and visits to Cappadocia's most stunning landscapes and historic treasures.

gallery.title: Experience Gallery
gallery.desc: Explore the stunning landscapes of Cappadocia

overview.title: Overview
overview.para1: Experience the ultimate journey through Cappadocia's most stunning locations with our exclusive VIP Mercedes tour. This full-day adventure is designed for those who want to see the very best of the region in comfort and style, with an expert guide bringing each destination to life.
overview.dest1Desc: Start your journey with breathtaking views over the fairy chimneys and valleys. This perfect vantage point offers incredible photo opportunities and a stunning introduction to Cappadocia's unique landscape.
overview.dest2Desc: Visit the highest point in Cappadocia. This natural rock fortress offers panoramic views of the entire region. Learn about its historical significance as an ancient defense system and marvel at the intricate cave dwellings carved into the rock.
overview.dest3Desc: Walk through this stunning valley named after the thousands of pigeon houses carved into the rocks. Discover why pigeons were so important to the local economy and enjoy the peaceful atmosphere of this natural wonder.
overview.dest4Desc: Descend into one of Cappadocia's fascinating underground cities. Explore the multi-level network of tunnels, rooms, and storage areas that once sheltered thousands of people. Your guide will explain how these incredible structures were built and used throughout history.
overview.dest5Desc: Let your imagination run wild in this valley filled with unique rock formations resembling animals and figures. This lunar-like landscape is perfect for creative photography and offers a different perspective on Cappadocia's geological wonders.
overview.dest6Desc: Experience one of Cappadocia's most distinctive landscapes. This valley is famous for its towering fairy chimneys and stunning natural beauty. Walk among these magnificent formations and understand the geological processes that created them.
overview.dest7Desc: Discover the remarkable mushroom-shaped fairy chimneys where monks once lived in isolation. Visit the chapel dedicated to St. Simeon and see some of the most impressive rock formations in all of Cappadocia.
overview.dest8Desc: Explore this fascinating valley that served as a monastery settlement. Walk through ancient cave dwellings, churches, and tunnels connecting different valleys. Learn about the daily life of the communities that once thrived here.
overview.dest9Desc: End your day in this charming riverside town famous for its 4,000-year-old pottery tradition. Watch skilled artisans demonstrate the ancient craft on traditional kick-wheels and try your hand at creating your own piece of Cappadocian art.

Experience traditional Turkish culture with a visit to a carpet-weaving cooperative and enjoy lunch at a scenic location.

about.para1: Cappadocia is known as "Land of Beautiful Horses", and it's the perfect place to ride horses. Cappadocia's history has been marked by horses for thousands of years. The unique landscapes surrounding Goreme make it a great place to ride a Turkish cowboy or native Anatolian horse.
about.para2: Enjoy a 2- to 4-hour trail ride away from the crowds to explore the stunning valleys and spectacular views around Goreme. We offer trail rides all day and multi-day horseback excursions.
about.twoHourDesc: This journey takes you through some of the most picturesque valleys in Cappadocia, including Swords Valley, Meskendir Valley (Rose Valley), and Love Valley. You will be able to ride among the quince, apple, walnut orchards, as well as grape vines that are used in local wines.
about.fourHourDesc: These tours include not only the listed valleys, but also the stunning Pigeon, White, and Zemi Valleys. Experience breathtaking views of mountain tops and unspoiled landscapes along the trail.
about.para3: You will pass beautiful fairy chimneys, churches and other structures as you climb through volcanic stone hills. There are breathtaking views of mountain tops and unspoiled landscapes along the trail.

about.para1: Add an exclusive Pottery Making experience to complement your Cappadocia adventure. This hands-on activity pairs beautifully with hot air balloon flights and fairy chimney explorations, offering a cultural immersion into ancient artisan traditions.
about.para2: Experience the ancient pottery legacy of the Hittite Empire, using red clay from the Red River. This tradition dates back 4,500 to 5,000 years. Skilled artisans guide you through the techniques, and there's also an opportunity to shop for authentic pottery pieces.
about.para3: The experience lasts approximately 20 minutes. Hotel pickup is arranged about 1 hour before the pottery session. The pottery area is located near Cappadocia's famous Fairy Chimneys, providing excellent photo opportunities. After your session, a shuttle will return you to your hotel.
about.para4: Avanos is one of Cappadocia's most popular destinations, renowned for its pottery and ceramics tradition dating back to 200 BC. The wooden bridge crossing the Red River (Kızılırmak) is a symbol of the town, and the area offers a tranquil atmosphere perfect for exploring Turkish culture.

hero.title: Hamam (Turkish Bath)
hero.subtitle: 60-Minute Traditional Experience
hero.desc: Rejuvenate your mind and body with an authentic Turkish Bath experience in Cappadocia's ancient cave bathhouse.

about.title: About the Hamam
about.subtitle: Cappadocia Turkish Bath Experience
about.para1: Amidst the enchanting adventures that Cappadocia offers, it's only natural to crave a moment of tranquility. The thrill of exploring this region can be exhilarating but also tiring. If you're seeking the perfect pause between your activities, the Cappadocia Hamam experience is your go-to retreat. Whether you choose to indulge in the morning, afternoon, or evening, the Turkish Bath in Cappadocia promises to rejuvenate both your mind and body, allowing you to fully savor your holiday.
about.para2: The Cappadocia Hamam has been a cornerstone of this region for generations, drawing visitors from around the globe. While you marvel at Cappadocia's natural wonders, the human-made marvels like this bathhouse, carved into ancient caves, offer their own allure. The fusion of traditional Turkish Bath rituals with modern spa luxuries creates an experience that is both unique and deeply satisfying.
about.para3: The Turkish Bath in Cappadocia is designed to wash away the stress of daily life, leaving you refreshed and renewed. As you recline on the warm marble, feel the soothing heat as it envelops you, preparing you for the next stage of relaxation. Your skilled attendant—be it a tellak for men or a natir for women—will gently pour warm water over you, followed by a traditional scrub and foam massage that is the essence of the Turkish Bath experience. In this serene and authentic setting, you'll enjoy a pampering session like no other, leaving you utterly relaxed and revitalized.
about.para4: This timeless bathing ritual will leave you feeling warm, comfortable, and thoroughly cleansed. Your experience begins with being wrapped in a soft cotton peştemal and entering the steam room to prepare your skin for the rejuvenating scrub. The scrub will leave your skin soft and refreshed, followed by a delightful soap bubble massage with a unique, silky texture. You can also choose to complete your relaxation with an oil massage, tailored to your preferences. While men and women typically bathe separately, couples can arrange a shared experience. The bathhouse itself is a pristine, elegant underground space, providing secure storage for your belongings as you unwind.
about.para5: Whether you're planning a weekend escape or an extended holiday, staying in one of Cappadocia's cliffside hotels offers the perfect opportunity to visit the traditional Turkish Bath after a day of exploration. Many tourists consider this experience a must during their Cappadocia tour. There's simply no better way to unwind in Turkey than with a traditional Hammam. Entrusting yourself to the hands of experienced masseuses is an ideal way to release stress and tension, leaving you with a renewed sense of peace and well-being. After your bath, the world will feel like a better place, and you'll undoubtedly be eager to return.

about.title: About the Show
about.subtitle: Turkish Night Show Experience
about.para1: Turkish Night Shows take you on a journey through the traditional dance styles of Turkey's various regions, beautifully performed in traditional costumes. The evening is filled with exhilarating belly dancing, making it a highly energetic experience. Whether you choose to participate or simply watch, these performances celebrate the rich tradition of traditional Turkish music and dance in an atmosphere brimming with joy and excitement. This dinner party is all about celebrating heritage, and you're invited to join in the festivities if you wish!
about.para2: We will pick you up at 20:30 from your hotel during summer months (20:00 during winter months), and take you to the cave restaurant where the Turkish Night Show takes place each night.
about.para3: The show begins with Turkish folk dancers showcasing traditional dances, followed by a traditional Turkish wedding ceremony that is sure to delight. This ceremony features a groom and a bride, with the groom performing to show that he is handsome, strong, and rich. The bride arrives looking lovely in her red dress. At first, she refuses the groom, explaining that his heart is only beating to pay the bride's price, not out of love. Only after the groom proves his love will they perform the traditional wedding dance, and all guests are invited to the floor to join in!
about.para4: After the Turkish folk dances from all over Turkey, the main attraction of the night—the belly dancer—arrives to grace the stage. Her breathtaking dance performance is mesmerizing, and then she takes one man from each table to teach them some basic moves. The men always have a blast trying their hand at belly dancing!
about.para5: The night concludes with other entertaining shows, including fire dancing, a Caucasian show featuring traditional dances with knives, and a drum show. Finally, we'll drive you back to your hotel, where you'll drift into a deep and restful sleep.
about.para6: Throughout the night, waiters will serve you unlimited soft drinks and alcoholic beverages, along with appetizers to enjoy. The main dish is lamb served with rice—a traditional Turkish wedding meal—though a chicken meal option is also available.
